about_the_game:
Description:
Enhance your RPG Maker MZ game with the Simple Cooking System Plugin!

This plugin allows players to combine ingredients (Items) using a variety of tools to create unique dishes, special items, or valuable crafting materials.
Transform your gameplay with this engaging and intuitive cooking mechanic!

Key Features:
- Access a Recipe Book System to organize and easily load your recipes.

- Unlock recipes with switches or through event commands.

- Enable failure rates for recipes, including custom failure items.

- Use advanced tools with disabled conditions and sound effects.

- Easily manage ingredients and allow adjustable quantities.

- Integrate seamlessly with your game through plugin parameters.



What's in this package?

Attached is a compressed file containing:

  - The Multi Clothes plugin file: "SimpleCookingSystem.js":
Including all versions released to date.
(May include "Release" and "Alternative" versions)

- The "Plugin Support" folder contains an HTML file that, when run, will display more information about the plugin. (Plugin demonstration video, support links*, among other things)
* Important: Support is only available in English and Spanish.

- The plugin documentation is included within the plugin itself; you can read it through the RPG MAKER MZ Plugin Editor (Only available in English)


If you have questions about other topics, please visit our support page for more information.

----------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
